jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Position

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead delivery of complex carrier and partner integrations enabling Hiya products

This role is delivery-focused, highly cross-functional, and deeply technical. You will be the primary point of contact between Hiya and carriers and partners across EMEA, ensuring each integration is planned, executed, tracked, and delivered. .

You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Specialists, Customer Success, and external carrier technical teams to bring new product integrations to life.

This role is based in London with an expectation of 3 days/week in-office. Hiya is a global company, with meeting times optimized across timezones.

What You’ll Do

Program & Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end delivery integrations, from kickoff through deployment.

  • Define and manage realistic project plans milestones, dependencies, and risk registers.

  • Run weekly internal and external technical planning meetings, maintain project tracking docs, and ensure all stakeholders are aligned.

  • Ensure carriers and partners deliver their components on time (e.g., solution design inputs, network connectivity, integration configuration, data elements, test dependencies and test results, and delivery artifacts and related sign-offs,).

Technical Leadership & Problem Solving

  • Bring technical fluency in REST APIs, AWS services, and SIP/telephony basics.

  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, Engineering and Product to clarify requirements, validate API data and plan delivery.

  • Manage completion of Hiya’s technical delivery tasks and delivery lifecycle gates.

  • Identify technical blockers early, escalate appropriately, and drive resolution across teams.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

  • Act as the trusted point of contact for carriers and partners, ensuring expectations, timelines, and responsibilities are clear.
    Manage cross-functional communication with Solution Architect, Engineering, Success, Product, and leadership.

  • Present clear, concise updates to both technical and non-technical audiences internally and externally.

  • Build strong partnerships through collaborative persistence, clarity, and a bias toward action.

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to improving delivery practices, templates, and tooling for repeatability across future delivery programs.

  • Contribute to tailoring delivery framework to align with emerging new product deliveries.

  • Identify gaps in process, communication, or documentation and proactively address them.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years in technical program management or complex technical project delivery (SaaS preferred).

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle basics, Jira for ticket management, and program management methodologies is required.

  • Experience leading integrations involving APIs, AWS, and complex technical data flows.

  • Background in telecom, carriers, SIP/telephony, or adjacent industries

  • Proven experience owning large implementations end-to-end, with hands-on involvement in requirements, risks, and stakeholder alignment.

  • Strong command of implementation tracking (project plans, dependencies, RAID logs).

  • AI fluency: hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate program work and reduce manual labor, such as planning, status reporting, risk analysis, and documentation, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential internal and external data.

These qualities reflect Hiya’s core values of Serving our customers, Doing rather than observing, Improving ourselves and our business, Owning and holding ourselves accountable for success, and Leading by showing up:

  • Serve our customers – You lead with empathy, always seeking to understand customer challenges and provide solutions that deliver real value.

  • Do rather than observe – You take initiative, move deals forward with urgency, and find creative ways to overcome obstacles.

  • Improve yourself and our business – You embrace feedback, refine your craft, and seek opportunities to make our sales process and customer experience even better.

  • Own and hold yourself accountable for success – You take responsibility for your results, celebrate wins, and learn from setbacks without excuses.

  • Lead by showing up – You bring a clear point of view, engage in open and respectful discussion, and commit fully to team decisions that move Hiya forward.

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

More Details

  • Start Date: Immediately

  • Status: Full-time

  • Type: Hybrid

  • Location: London, UK

  • Travel Requirements: Some

  • Department: Business Development

  • Reports to: Head of Global Delivery Programs

Benefits

  • 25 holiday plus bank holidays

  • Opt in salary sacrifice pension scheme (company full 4% of basic salary contribution)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Private medical insurance through Vitality (including dental & vision)

  • Employer-paid life insurance 2x base salary

  • Donation Matching for a charity of your choice (up to $1,000/ year)

  • WFH equipment stipend

  • $1,000/year in Professional Development funds

  • Lunch provided on in- office days

This position is based in London, UK. Office post code: W1F 8WE

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated Talent Operations Specialist to join our team in a key individual contributor role. This position owns program management for Global University Recruiting, end-to-end interview scheduling and coordination, recruiting operations, and special projects. The ideal candidate will be an Ashby power-user who thrives on building smooth, scalable recruiting processes and driving cross-functional programs, collaborating closely with stakeholders across the business.

This is not a full-cycle recruiting role. Instead, it's built for someone who wants to own the operational backbone of recruiting, including program management, coordination, systems, and process, at a level that carries real ownership and visibility across the org.

At Hiya, we are passionate about innovation and committed to excellence, striving to build a team that embodies our core values. With numerous opportunities for professional development and visibility within the organization, this role offers the chance to make a significant impact in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

  • Global University Recruiting Program Management: Own the end-to-end planning, relationship management and execution of our Global University Recruiting program, including career fairs, campus partnerships, internship pipelines, and virtual or in-person recruiting events. Some travel may be required to support on-campus programs and events.

  • Scheduling & Interview Coordination: Own scheduling and coordination for open roles and recruiting projects across the business, managing complex, multi-stakeholder interview logistics with a high bar for accuracy and candidate experience.

  • Ashby (ATS) Ownership: Serve as our go-to Ashby expert, managing workflows, templates, data integrity, and reporting, and partnering with Recruiting Ops to continuously improve how the system supports the team, including evaluating and implementing AI-powered tools to streamline scheduling, sourcing support, and candidate communication.

  • Candidate Experience Management: Ensure a positive, engaging, and consistent experience for all candidates, from initial contact to final offer, with transparent communication and timely feedback throughout.

  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with hiring managers, recruiters, and department heads to align on process, timelines, and logistics, providing operational guidance so recruiting programs run efficiently, without owning full-cycle candidate sourcing or closing.

  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage recruiting metrics and AI-assisted analytics to track program and pipeline performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend process improvements.

  • Special Projects: Lead and contribute to recruiting-related projects, such as employer branding initiatives, process improvements, and ad-hoc operational needs, as an owner, not just a contributor.

What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting coordination, or talent program management, with a track record of owning processes independently rather than just executing them.

  • Hands-on Ashby expertise, including building and scaling ATS workflows, templates, and configurations, not just day-to-day use.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder interview scheduling and logistics, including panels across multiple time zones and calendars.

  • Experience planning and executing university or campus recruiting programs and events, with willingness to travel occasionally to support on-campus programs.

  • Comfort using recruiting data and analytics to identify trends and drive process improvements, not just track metrics.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to own a special project or process improvement from scope to completion with minimal oversight.

  • Advanced proficiency using AI tools to improve recruiting workflows, from scheduling and communication to process design and data analysis, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them.

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience supporting technical or high-volume hiring at a fast-growing tech or SaaS company.

  • Experience mentoring or providing guidance to junior coordinators or operations team members.

  • Exposure to employer branding or candidate marketing initiatives.

  • Familiarity with recruiting tech stack tools beyond the core ATS (Google Suite, scheduling tools, HRIS platforms).

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

How We Invest in You

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About Us

At Hiya, we're making calls safe, useful, and human again.

Voice is the most human form of communication, yet it's become one of the least trusted. Spam, scams, and AI manipulation have eroded what was once a simple way to connect. Hiya is changing that.

Each month our AI voice technology analyzes 28+ billion calls, protecting over 550 million users and 800+ businesses worldwide. Partnering with a growing global network including, AT&T, Samsung, British Telecom EE, Rogers, MasOrange,Bell Canada, MasMovil, and Virgin Media O2, we're not just stopping bad actors, we're helping people feel good and confident about picking up the phone again.

This is a pivotal moment for voice. As new threats and technologies accelerate, so does demand for trusted voice communication. Hiya is growing 40%+ year over year, expanding globally, and defining what voice becomes next.

Join us! You won't just work on what voice is today, you'll shape what it becomes tomorrow: smarter, safer, and genuinely worth answering again.

About the Role

Hiya is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Protect team, responsible for building and scaling the AI-powered spam and scam detection systems that protect hundreds of millions of people from fraudulent calls before they ring. As voice threats evolve faster than ever; driven by AI-generated abuse, sophisticated spoofing, and increasingly complex attack patterns. You'll own the end-to-end pipeline that enables our data science team to develop increasingly sophisticated scam detection models while maintaining strict privacy and regulatory compliance. You'll shape how protection scales across our network, how quickly we adapt to new threats, and how effectively we translate AI innovation into real-world safety outcomes.

  • Own the complete development lifecycle for spam and scam detection infrastructure - from researching and proposing solutions to implementation, testing, deployment, production maintenance, and monitoring

  • Participate in on-call rotation, ensuring rapid recognition and resolution of production issues while continuously improving system reliability

  • Design and build frameworks that enable data scientists to develop, test, and deploy increasingly complex scam detection models with access to call data in a privacy-aware, regulation-compliant manner

  • Make independent implementation decisions while driving collaborative design discussions that improve system quality, long-term maintainability, and cost-effectiveness across the team

  • Evaluate critical tradeoffs between immediate fixes and durable solutions when production issues arise, prioritizing overall service quality and system resilience

  • Recognize and evangelize engineering patterns, design principles and architectural decisions that could be adopted across teams to raise overall quality and execution speed

  • Influence how the team operates by pushing back on solutions that don't align with design principles, surfacing issues early during project planning, and reasoning clearly about business impact versus cost

Required

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, with strong expertise in distributed systems, microservices, network architecture, and database systems

  • Proven experience operating distributed systems in production environments

  • Ability to quickly recognize, diagnose and resolve production issues

  • Relevant technical experience may include:

    • RxM engineering

    • TCP/IP

    • DNS resolution

    • Web backend development

  • Ability to evaluate tradeoffs between immediate fixes and long-term solutions

  • Strong focus on service quality, reliability and system resilience

  • Ability to work independently on implementation while knowing when to involve others in design discussions

  • Confidence making well-informed technical decisions and clearly explaining tradeoffs

  • Interest in agentic workflows, including engineering automation and customer-facing applications

Preferred

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience building frameworks or infrastructure that support data science or machine learning workflows

  • Functional programming experience

  • Experience with data processing pipelines, especially Kafka or similar technologies

  • Familiarity with client-side processing pipelines

  • DevOps, monitoring, and observability experience

  • Familiarity with on-call rotation

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

Process Overview

  • Initial Screen: We confirm baseline alignment, role interest, relevant experience, and logistics.

  • Hiring Manager (HM) Screen: We evaluate role fit, expectations, and execution readiness.

  • Take Home Working Assignment: You'll complete a take-home, role-relevant assignment designed to reflect the kind of work you would do at Hiya. The assignment focuses on how you think, prioritize, and explain your approach. You'll review your work and discuss your reasoning with the interview panel

  • Onsite Interview Loop: You’ll participate in a live, role-relevant working session as part of an interview loop with multiple interviewers. This experience is designed to reflect how work is done at Hiya and focuses on your real-time problem-solving and collaboration skills. During the session, you’ll work through your take-home assignment live and walk interviewers through your thinking as you go. Interviewers will explore how you structure problems, communicate your reasoning, respond to questions and feedback, and adapt your approach in the moment. Part of this loop also includes our Hiya Future Values Interview; an independent conversation focused on your long-term potential, judgment under ambiguity, and ability to create sustained value as scope and complexity increase.

• Reference Check: As a final step, we connect with 2–3 past supervisors to gain additional perspective on your experience and working style, and to further understand how you align with Hiya’s values.

About the Role

We are hiring an Account Director to lead carrier partnerships and commercial growth in Brazil. Based in São Paulo, you will drive Hiya's expansion across Brazil with a view to broader LATAM coverage over time. This is a strategic, high-impact role for someone who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments and wants to build something meaningful in one of the world's most dynamic telecom markets.

You will own the full commercial lifecycle, from market development and executive relationship-building through to deal negotiation, execution, and long-term account growth. You will define and execute Hiya's Brazil strategy and work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Legal, Customer Success, and Leadership to bring our voice intelligence solutions to market.

This role is critical to the success of Hiya. You will be a key player in a small but global team that interacts with the largest brand-name Mobile Network Operators in the world.

What You'll Own

• Develop and execute Hiya's commercial strategy across Brazil

• Build and maintain senior relationships with telecom operators, carriers, and strategic partners across the region

• Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities

• Lead complex commercial negotiations and long-form partnership discussions

• Drive revenue growth across new and existing accounts

• Represent customer and market needs internally to shape product and go-to-market strategy

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to support successful launches and partner growth

• Track market dynamics, competitive activity, and regulatory and industry trends across Brazil and LATAM

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, enterprise sales, or carrier/operator sales

• Proven ability to drive business development in the Brazilian market

• Strong experience working with telecommunications operators or large enterprise accounts

• Proven track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals

• Strong executive presence and relationship management skills

• Commercially driven, with sharp strategic thinking and execution capability

• Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

• Must hold a valid Brazilian work authorisation or right-to-work status

• Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is an advantage

Nice to Have

• Business development experience in other LATAM markets (Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Chile) is a strong plus

• Experience in telecom services, mobile networks, voice, fraud, or security products

• Existing relationships within the Brazilian or LATAM telecom ecosystem

• Experience working with SaaS, platform, or AI-driven products

• Exposure to international or multi-market commercial environments

• Technical fluency and the ability to engage in solution-design conversations with product, engineering, and data teams

How We Work

• Own it: We expect team members to take real ownership and move with purpose. Observers don't thrive here.

• High trust, high bar: We serve customers and partners with a standard for quality we don't compromise on.

• Learn in public: Mistakes happen. What matters is that we reflect, adapt, and share what we learned.

• Lead with conviction: We make calls, we back them, and we stay collaborative while doing it.

• Do, don't observe: Velocity and execution are core to how we operate, across every function.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and annual bonus: Structured OTE with upside tied to market performance.

• Hybrid working: Based in São Paulo with flexibility on where and how you work.

• Annual professional development budget: Dedicated investment in your growth and skills.

• Home office support: We'll help you set up a productive working environment.

• International collaboration: Work closely with teams across the US, UK, EMEA, and APAC, with travel to match.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

The Protect team at Hiya builds products at the intersection of voice, telephony, and artificial intelligence. Our work spans both audio intelligence (e.g., deepfake detection, fraud intent detection, etc.) and conversational AI, specifically on voice AI agents that enhance protection and productivity for consumers in their mobile devices. We train our own proprietary models and use third-party solutions to complement our core offering.

Our products need to delight the end-users while at the same type provide strategic and commercial value to our telecom operator partners.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a key role in the team by leading one (or multiple of) these products. We are looking for someone that can work both at a strategic level, defining the vision and “why” we build what we build, while at the same time is very hands-on in the product development process, working side by side with engineers with a very clear “builder” mentality, going deep into the technical details of the solution.

The core of this role is not aimed at managing a backlog, running sprint plannings and standups and writing PRDs. This is a role that needs to be close to our customers to understand what they want, transform uncertainty into clarity, connect dots, build a product vision and execute it. You will own the product end-to-end.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Talk a lot to customers (telecom operators) and understand what they want and why.

  • Form a product vision to solve our customers and users problems.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly, say “no” a lot and make sure that everyone (team, customers and internal stakeholders) understands what we are doing and why.

  • Work closely with other teams at Hiya, in particular:

    • With our Engineering team to execute the vision, being hands on, setting priorities and prototyping ideas yourself. Sometimes creating your own PRs.

    • With our Research team to prioritze our model training roadmap.

    • With our Revenue team to uncover customer needs, price our products and support them in customer-facing meetings and events.

    • With our Legal team to understand how regulation shapes our product.

    • With our Finance team to work on our product economics, business cases and investment decisions.

This is role is for you if:

  • You have at least one of the following experiences: (1) worked in product management at a venture-backed startup, (2) you have been a founder or early employee in a startup and were close to the product or (3) you have been a management consultant (MBB) and can prove that tech is not a new thing to you.

  • You likely have a technical background either by education or professionally.

  • You have a strong sense of urgency when you execute and instill that to the people that surround you.

  • The idea of building AI solutions that will impact millions of people in their day-to-day communications excites you.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty and you embrace autonomy, charting your own path and knowing when to ask for help.

  • You are very curious and like to understand how things work and are not afraid of trying or learning new things very fast.

  • Your way of working includes AI at its core to multiply the speed and quality of what you do.

  • You are close to the tech and AI ecosystem and you feel an urge to test the last model or product that was just launched.

  • You have excellent communication skills both written and spoken and you are able to structure your thoughts clearly to deliver your ideas to people.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI or voice AI either at the model, orchestration or application layer.

  • You have launched successful products before as PM.

  • You can show something you have built yourself without an engineer.

  • You have done something out of the normal in your life that shaped you to be who you are today.

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems. We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You’ll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results—while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:
